content: <thought>Based on the molecular formula (C6H9O2), DBE = 3, presence of one carbonyl group, three methyl groups, and two aromatic carbons (both fully substituted), the molecule can be viewed as being assembled from a carbonyl‑containing fragment and a tert‑butyl‑type fragment. The SMILES strings for these fragments are “CC(=O)” (an acetyl fragment) and “C(C)(C)C” (a tert‑butyl fragment). These fragments can be joined to give a structure consistent with the provided data.
